race.comment: LOADED (2) was in the market on debut at Pakenham Synthetic and ran well but just found one better, beaten half a length. Better for that and will be very hard to hold out with natural improvement. BIG KAPOW (1) was good fresh at Moe when only run down late then ran midfield at Cranbourne in a handy maiden. Peaks now and should take plenty of catching. ARMORWARE (8) finished third last time over 1200m at Pakenham Synthetic, beaten 4.5 lengths behind a smart one. The debut was also good and he can improve again. INCOHERENT (6) bumped into a very nice winner on debut at Kyneton and that form should hold up. Respecting.
